retention_tricks: Rapid Cuts: Keep visual pace high, change shots every 1-2 seconds.
Text Overlays: Reinforce key points, add humor, keep viewers engaged with text.
Sound Design: Use trendy sounds, sound effects for impact, background music.
Pattern Interrupts: Unexpected visual/audio changes, sudden zoom ins/outs.
Open Loops: Hint at future revelation, make viewers wait for the payoff.
Energy Shift: Start high energy, then a brief pause for emphasis, then back to high energy.
